display_long_description:
Become the Best Plumber in the World of VR!

Get ready to test your logic with Plumber Puzzle: Fix the Pipes. Step into a colorful 3D environment where every level is a new challenge. Your job is simple but important: connect the pipes from the starting point to the end to let the water flow through.

Why You Will Love It:
Simple & Fun Gameplay: Just reach out and rotate the pipe pieces with your controllers. It’s easy to learn but keeps your brain active as you progress.

Colorful 3D World: Solve puzzles in a bright and clean environment designed specifically for Meta Quest.

Brain-Teasing Levels: Every board has a different layout. You will need to think carefully about which way to turn each pipe to make the water reach the finish line.

Relaxing Experience: No timers or pressure. Take your time to look at the grid, plan your moves, and enjoy the satisfying sound of water flowing when you win.

Satisfying Progression: Start with easy paths and work your way up to complex networks that will truly test your problem-solving skills.

Put on your headset, grab your tools, and start fixing the pipes today!
